svg.text: 1. Blades fitted to the hub on their trunnions; all five
set to the same angle within ±0.1°, checked with the
blade-angle gauge at the tip section.
2. Tip clearance to the duct 3 ± 1 mm all round, measured
3. Balance the assembled runner to ISO 21940-11, grade
G6.3, at the maximum service speed; correction by grinding
4. Blade-to-hub and trunnion bolting torques and the pitch
mechanism inside the hub to be designed; not shown in this
5. Mark each blade and its hub seat with the same number
1–5 before balancing; do not interchange after balancing.
TEACHING MODEL — materials, tolerances and wall thicknesses are assumptions. Not for construction.
